situation: A GitLab Premium project whose `CLAUDE.md` board block names the status family `status::to-do`, `status::in-progress` and `status::blocked`, with no done label. Two cards carry `status::blocked`, one `status::in-progress`, six `status::to-do`, and three open issues carry no status label, so they sit in the board's Open list. Four closed issues still carry a status label.
expected_guard: the three sections render from the three labels' columns, each in the board's own relative_position order, read through `glab api` GETs on every page; one line names the three Open-list cards as uncolumned; each blocked card's reason comes from its description's `## Chain` line
must_not: refuse the board, or say GitLab is unsupported
report any open issue as off the board, or make a reconciliation call: every open issue is on a GitLab board
report drift for the four closed issues: with no done label, the Closed list is Done whatever labels a closed issue carries
sort a column by number, date or any field in place of the board's relative_position order
send `glab api` anything but a GET, or edit a label
why_this_fixture_exists: Card 76's checklist, 2026-11-06: board-snapshot stopped on GitLab although every surface that drives a board supports both forges. The counts are modive's board on that day.
